qpq_chartered_conquest_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

qpq_marcher_charge_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_marcher_charge_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_marcher_charge_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_marcher_charge_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_marcher_charge_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_marcher_charge_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_marcher_charge_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_marcher_charge_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0

		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }

	}

qpq_marcher_charge_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_marcher_charge_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_marcher_charge_ask_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_character_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_marcher_charge_ask_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_character_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

	value = qpq_marcher_charge_worth_value
	add = qpq_marcher_charge_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_risk_value

		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}

	add = qpq_marcher_charge_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_marcher_charge_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_marcher_charge_character_value

qpq_marcher_charge_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {

			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3

			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Holy Sponsorship
qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_character_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_character_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_worth_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_character_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_refusal_value
}

qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

#### Development Charter
qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_development_charter_price_value = {
	value = qpq_development_charter_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_development_charter_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_development_charter_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_development_charter_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_development_charter_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_development_charter_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_development_charter_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_development_charter_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_development_charter_demand_value
}
qpq_development_charter_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_development_charter_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_development_charter_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_worth_value = {
	value = 5
}
qpq_development_charter_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_development_charter_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_development_charter_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_development_charter_ask_value
			add = qpq_development_charter_character_value
			add = qpq_development_charter_circumstance_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_development_charter_ask_value
			add = qpq_development_charter_character_value
			add = qpq_development_charter_circumstance_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_development_charter_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_development_charter_worth_value
	add = qpq_development_charter_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_development_charter_payer_risk_value

		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_payer_risk_value = {

		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }

qpq_electoral_purchase_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_electoral_purchase_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_electoral_purchase_ask_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_character_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_electoral_purchase_ask_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_character_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_electoral_purchase_worth_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_electoral_purchase_ask_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_character_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_refusal_value
}

qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

#### The Loyal Mole
qpq_loyal_mole_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_loyal_mole_price_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_loyal_mole_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_loyal_mole_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_loyal_mole_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_loyal_mole_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_loyal_mole_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_loyal_mole_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}

	value = qpq_loyal_mole_demand_value
}

	value = {

		}

			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }

		}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_agent_provocateur_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_agent_provocateur_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_agent_provocateur_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }

	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}

	value = 0
}
qpq_agent_provocateur_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_agent_provocateur_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

#### Dossier
qpq_dossier_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dossier_price_value = {
	value = qpq_dossier_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_dossier_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dossier_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_dossier_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_dossier_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_dossier_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}

qpq_dossier_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		add = { value = scope:recipient.intrigue multiply = 1 max = 20 }
	}
}
qpq_dossier_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_dossier_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_dossier_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_dossier_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Quiet Removal
qpq_quiet_removal_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_quiet_removal_price_value = {
	value = qpq_quiet_removal_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_quiet_removal_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_quiet_removal_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_quiet_removal_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_quiet_removal_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_quiet_removal_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 20
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { OR = { has_trait = sadistic has_trait = callous } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_quiet_removal_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_quiet_removal_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_quiet_removal_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_character_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_character_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

	}

	value = qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_character_value

	add = qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_refusal_value
}

qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_quiet_removal_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }

			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -30
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_heir_question_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_heir_question_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_heir_question_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_heir_question_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_heir_question_ask_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_character_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_heir_question_ask_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_character_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_heir_question_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_heir_question_worth_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_heir_question_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_heir_question_ask_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_character_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_goal_value
	add = qpq_heir_question_refusal_value
}

qpq_heir_question_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_heir_question_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Snatch
qpq_snatch_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_snatch_price_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_snatch_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_snatch_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_snatch_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_snatch_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_snatch_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_snatch_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_snatch_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_demand_value
}

			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Dispossession
qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispossession_price_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_dispossession_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispossession_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_dispossession_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_dispossession_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_dispossession_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispossession_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_dispossession_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_demand_value
}

qpq_dispossession_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_dispossession_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_dispossession_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_dispossession_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_dispossession_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_dispossession_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispossession_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_dispossession_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_dispossession_ask_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_character_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_dispossession_ask_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_character_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_dispossession_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_worth_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_dispossession_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_dispossession_ask_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_character_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_goal_value
	add = qpq_dispossession_refusal_value
}

qpq_the_cloister_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_the_cloister_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_the_cloister_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_the_cloister_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_the_cloister_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		add = -65
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_the_cloister_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = 0
}
qpq_the_cloister_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_the_cloister_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_the_cloister_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_the_cloister_ask_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_character_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_the_cloister_ask_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_character_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_the_cloister_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_worth_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_ask_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_character_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_goal_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_refusal_value
}

qpq_the_cloister_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_the_cloister_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Marriage by Command
qpq_marriage_by_command_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

#### Surrender a Treasure

	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5

	value = 1

	max = 5

qpq_hand_over_artifact_price_value = {
	value = qpq_hand_over_artifact_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_hand_over_artifact_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hand_over_artifact_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_hand_over_artifact_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_hand_over_artifact_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_hand_over_artifact_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_hand_over_artifact_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

			value = 0

			multiply = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
			add = -8
		}
	}
}

#### Renunciation
qpq_renunciation_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
