		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_renunciation_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_renunciation_dread_value = {
	value = 0

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_renunciation_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_renunciation_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_renunciation_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_renunciation_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_renunciation_ask_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_character_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_renunciation_ask_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_character_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_renunciation_goal_value
			max = 0
		}

qpq_renunciation_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_renunciation_worth_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}

qpq_renunciation_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_renunciation_ask_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_character_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_goal_value
	add = qpq_renunciation_refusal_value
}

qpq_renunciation_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		add = {
			value = 0
			scope:target = {
				if = {
					limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
					add = -30
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
					add = -18
				}
				else = {
					add = -8
				}
			}
			multiply = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = -5
		}
	}
}

qpq_renunciation_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		add = {
			value = 0
			scope:target = {
				if = {
					limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
					add = 60
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
					add = 40
				}
				else = {
					add = 25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 5
		}
	}
}

#### Hush Money
qpq_hush_money_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hush_money_price_value = {
	value = qpq_hush_money_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_hush_money_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hush_money_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_hush_money_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_hush_money_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_hush_money_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value

				multiply = 0.8
			}

			add = -6

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }

		add = 14

		}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
		add = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_ct_levy_up_cost_value
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
		add = 18
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier = tier_county } }
			add = 6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier = tier_duchy } }
			add = 16
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier = tier_kingdom } }
			add = 28
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier = tier_empire } }
			add = 40
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = 25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
		add = 15
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = 15
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost }
			add = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost
		}
		else = {
			add = 20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
		add = 5
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.5 } } }
			add = 5
		}
	}
	min = 0
}

	value = 0
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_worth_value = {
	value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_ask_value
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = 0
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_offer_points_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_demand_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_goods_points_value
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_ask_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_character_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_value
	add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_refusal_value
}

qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Blessing for a Feud
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_price_value = {
	value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ask_value
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_character_value

			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ask_value
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_character_value
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ask_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_character_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_refusal_value
}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Clemency Bargain
qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_price_value = {
	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_clemency_bargain_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_clemency_bargain_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_clemency_bargain_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_demand_value
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_offer_points_value = {

		value = 0
		if = {

		if = {

		if = {

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }

			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		add = 30
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_worth_value = {
	value = 19
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_clemency_bargain_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_clemency_bargain_ask_value
			add = qpq_clemency_bargain_character_value
			add = qpq_clemency_bargain_circumstance_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_clemency_bargain_ask_value
			add = qpq_clemency_bargain_character_value
			add = qpq_clemency_bargain_circumstance_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_clemency_bargain_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_worth_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}

	value = qpq_clemency_bargain_ask_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_character_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_clemency_bargain_refusal_value
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor.liege value <= -20 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_worth_value = {
	value = 25
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_character_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_character_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_worth_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_character_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_refusal_value
}

qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
			add = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
			add = -8
		}
	}
}

qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
			add = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
			add = -8
		}
	}
}

#### Faction Pledge
qpq_faction_pledge_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_faction_pledge_price_value = {
	value = qpq_faction_pledge_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_faction_pledge_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_faction_pledge_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_faction_pledge_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_faction_pledge_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_faction_pledge_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_faction_pledge_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_faction_pledge_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_faction_pledge_demand_value
}
qpq_faction_pledge_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_faction_pledge_gold_points_value
		}

			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}

#### Transfer a County
qpq_title_swap_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
			NOT = { scope:qpq_x_consent ?= yes }
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
			NOT = { scope:qpq_x_consent ?= yes }
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_title_swap_price_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_title_swap_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}

qpq_title_swap_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_title_swap_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_title_swap_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_title_swap_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_title_swap_ask_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_character_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_title_swap_ask_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_character_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_title_swap_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

	value = qpq_title_swap_worth_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_payer_risk_value

		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_ask_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_character_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_goal_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_refusal_value
}

qpq_title_swap_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		add = {
			value = 0
			scope:target = {
				if = {
					limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
					add = -30
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
					add = -18
				}
				else = {
					add = -8
				}
			}
			multiply = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = -5
		}
	}
}

qpq_title_swap_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		add = {
			value = 0
			scope:target = {
				if = {
					limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
					add = 60
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
					add = 40
				}
				else = {
					add = 25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 5
		}
	}
}

#### Coup Pact
qpq_coup_pact_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_coup_pact_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_coup_pact_price_value = {
	value = qpq_coup_pact_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_coup_pact_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_coup_pact_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_coup_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_coup_pact_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_coup_pact_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_coup_pact_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_coup_pact_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_coup_pact_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:actor.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Proxy War
qpq_proxy_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { NOT = { liege ?= scope:actor } } }
		add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_proxy_war_price_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_proxy_war_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_proxy_war_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_proxy_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_proxy_war_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_proxy_war_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_proxy_war_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_proxy_war_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_demand_value
}

qpq_proxy_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven }
		}
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -20
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_proxy_war_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = 0
}

	multiply = -5
}

qpq_proxy_war_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_proxy_war_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_proxy_war_ask_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_character_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_proxy_war_ask_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_character_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_proxy_war_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

		multiply = -1.25
	}
}

	add = qpq_proxy_war_goodwill_value

}

qpq_proxy_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

qpq_partition_pact_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_partition_pact_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_partition_pact_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_partition_pact_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_partition_pact_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_partition_pact_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_partition_pact_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_partition_pact_ask_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_character_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_partition_pact_ask_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_character_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_partition_pact_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

qpq_partition_pact_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

qpq_partition_pact_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_secret_alliance_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:actor = { is_independent_ruler = no } } add = 3 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_independent_ruler = no } } add = 3 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_secret_alliance_price_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_alliance_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_secret_alliance_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_secret_alliance_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_secret_alliance_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_secret_alliance_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

}
qpq_secret_alliance_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_secret_alliance_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_secret_alliance_ask_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_character_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_secret_alliance_ask_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_character_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_secret_alliance_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_alliance_worth_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_secret_alliance_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_alliance_ask_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_character_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_refusal_value
}

qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_secret_alliance_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Bought Truce
qpq_bought_truce_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes } } add = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_clergy = yes } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_in_ongoing_great_holy_war = yes } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_truce_price_value = {
	value = qpq_bought_truce_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_bought_truce_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_bought_truce_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_bought_truce_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_bought_truce_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_bought_truce_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_bought_truce_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_bought_truce_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_bought_truce_demand_value
}
qpq_bought_truce_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_bought_truce_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {

			add = -5

			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_bought_truce_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_bought_truce_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_bought_truce_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes }
		}
		add = -60
	}
}
qpq_bought_truce_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_bought_truce_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

}

#### Faithless Ally
qpq_faithless_ally_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_dread_value = {
	value = 0

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 50 } }
		}
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_faithless_ally_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

		value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength
		divide = { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength min = 1 }
		multiply = 30
		max = 25
	}
}

	multiply = -5

qpq_faithless_ally_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_faithless_ally_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_faithless_ally_ask_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_character_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_faithless_ally_ask_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_character_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}

qpq_faithless_ally_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_faithless_ally_ask_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_character_value

	add = qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_refusal_value
}

qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_faithless_ally_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Turncoat
qpq_turncoat_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_turncoat_price_value = {
	value = qpq_turncoat_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_turncoat_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_turncoat_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_turncoat_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_turncoat_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_turncoat_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
