qpq_turncoat_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:recipient.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_turncoat_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:recipient.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:recipient.liege } } }
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Seed the Separatists
qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient.liege.faith = scope:actor.faith
			NOT = { scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient.liege } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -25
}

	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_demand_value
}

qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value <= -20 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_worth_value = {
	value = 25
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_ask_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_ask_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_worth_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_ask_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_refusal_value
}

qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
			add = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
			add = -8
		}
	}
}

qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {

		}
		if = {

			add = -10
		}
		if = {

			add = 8

			add = 6

			add = 4

#### Shelter the Pretender
qpq_shelter_the_pretender_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_armies ?= yes } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_shelter_the_pretender_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }

	}

qpq_shelter_the_pretender_circumstance_value = {

			always = yes

		limit = {
			scope:qpq_x_armies ?= yes
		}
		add = 20
	}

qpq_shelter_the_pretender_refusal_value = {
	value = 0

		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_shelter_the_pretender_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

#### Extradition
qpq_extradition_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege } }
		add = 2
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:secondary_recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:actor } }
			}
			add = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				OR = {
					is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
					is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
				AND = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					scope:secondary_recipient = {
						OR = {
							is_close_family_of = scope:recipient
							is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
							is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_extradition_price_value = {
	value = qpq_extradition_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_extradition_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_extradition_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_extradition_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_extradition_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_extradition_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}

qpq_extradition_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_extradition_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Buy a Councillor
qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {

			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}

		}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value >= 40 } }
		}
		add = -15
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_character_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_character_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_worth_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_character_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_refusal_value
}

qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:recipient.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_buy_a_councillor_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:recipient.liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}

	value = 0

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }

				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}

qpq_stay_home_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
			add = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
			add = -8
		}
	}
}

#### Defection Pact
qpq_defection_pact_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_defection_pact_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_defection_pact_price_value = {
	value = qpq_defection_pact_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_defection_pact_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_defection_pact_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_defection_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_defection_pact_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_defection_pact_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_defection_pact_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

#### Hire Holy Order Assassins
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value

		add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_ask_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_character_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_ask_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_character_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Excommunication for Hire
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	min = 0
	max = 5

		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ask_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_character_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ask_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_character_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_worth_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ask_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_character_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_refusal_value
}

qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Dispensation for Gold
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_price_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_demand_value
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_offer_points_value = {
	value = {

		if = {

			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}

#### Steer the Holy War
qpq_steer_the_holy_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		max = 100

		multiply = 0.8
	}

qpq_steer_the_holy_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}

				qpq_steer_the_holy_war_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

		}

		max = 0

			add = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_character_value

qpq_steer_the_holy_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

qpq_steer_the_holy_war_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Buy a Bishopric
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }

	}
	if = {

qpq_purchase_a_mitre_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

qpq_purchase_a_mitre_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

#### Bought Claim
qpq_bought_claim_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_claim_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_claim_price_value = {
	value = qpq_bought_claim_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_bought_claim_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_bought_claim_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_bought_claim_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_bought_claim_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_bought_claim_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_bought_claim_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_bought_claim_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Absolution by Concession

	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_price_value = {
	value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_absolution_by_concession_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }

			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_circumstance_value

			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_goal_value
			max = 0

	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_refusal_value

qpq_absolution_by_concession_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_absolution_by_concession_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Holy Warrant
qpq_holy_warrant_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5

		min = {
			value = qpq_holy_warrant_ask_value
			add = qpq_holy_warrant_character_value
			add = qpq_holy_warrant_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_holy_warrant_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

qpq_holy_warrant_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
			}
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -3
		}
	}
}

#### Buy a Bull
qpq_buy_a_bull_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_price_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_bull_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_buy_a_bull_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10

	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

	}

				qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:actor } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 18
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 10
			}
			add = {
				value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
				multiply = -0.2
				min = -15
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
				add = 8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
				add = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
				add = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
				add = -8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
				add = -4
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Conclave Votes
qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_conclave_votes_price_value = {
	value = qpq_conclave_votes_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_conclave_votes_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_conclave_votes_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_conclave_votes_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_conclave_votes_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
