qpq_conclave_votes_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_conclave_votes_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_conclave_votes_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_conclave_votes_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_conclave_votes_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_conclave_votes_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_conclave_votes_ask_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_character_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_conclave_votes_ask_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_character_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_conclave_votes_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_conclave_votes_worth_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_conclave_votes_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_conclave_votes_ask_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_character_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_goal_value
	add = qpq_conclave_votes_refusal_value
}

qpq_conclave_votes_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

qpq_conclave_votes_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = 0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_council_lobbying_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_council_lobbying_ask_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_character_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_goal_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_refusal_value
}

qpq_council_lobbying_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_council_lobbying_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Caliphal Investiture
qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_price_value = {
	value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_caliphal_investiture_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_caliphal_investiture_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_demand_value
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_offer_points_value = {

		if = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {

			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_worth_value = {
	value = 12
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_ask_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_character_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_ask_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_character_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

#### Name in the Khutba
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_ask_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_character_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_ask_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_character_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_worth_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_ask_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_character_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_value
	add = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_refusal_value
}

qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

#### Fatwa for Hire
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient scope:secondary_recipient = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_price_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_demand_value
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_points_value
		}

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = 0
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_payer_risk_value = {

	multiply = -5

qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_character_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_character_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}

	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_refusal_value
}

qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_fund_the_dawa_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_fund_the_dawa_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_fund_the_dawa_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_fund_the_dawa_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_fund_the_dawa_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_ask_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_character_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_ask_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_character_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
			add = -12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
			add = -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}

#### Crowning the Usurper
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.top_liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_price_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}

	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}

		multiply = 1.3

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }

	}

		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ask_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_character_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ask_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_character_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_worth_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_character_value

		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ask_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_character_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_refusal_value
}

qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.top_liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor.top_liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.top_liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.top_liege }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.top_liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor.top_liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.top_liege }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:actor.top_liege)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.top_liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.top_liege }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.top_liege }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Pliant Patriarch
qpq_pliant_patriarch_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_pliant_patriarch_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_pliant_patriarch_price_value = {
	value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_pliant_patriarch_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_pliant_patriarch_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_pliant_patriarch_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_pliant_patriarch_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_pliant_patriarch_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_pliant_patriarch_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}

qpq_pliant_patriarch_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_pliant_patriarch_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}

		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Favourable Omens
qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_price_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_favourable_omens_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_favourable_omens_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_favourable_omens_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}

	value = qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value
}

qpq_favourable_omens_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_favourable_omens_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_favourable_omens_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_favourable_omens_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_favourable_omens_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_character_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_character_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_worth_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_character_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_refusal_value
}

qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:actor } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 18
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 10
			}
			add = {
				value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
				multiply = -0.2
				min = -15
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
				add = 8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
				add = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
				add = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
				add = -8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
				add = -4
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_favourable_omens_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:actor } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 18
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 10
			}
			add = {
				value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
				multiply = -0.2
				min = -15
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
				add = 8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
				add = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
				add = -8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
				add = -4
			}
		}
		else = {
			add = 15
		}
	}
}

#### Consecration Rites
qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = dynasty }
					dynasty = { dynasty_prestige_level <= 1 }
					primary_title.title_held_years < 5
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_consecration_rites_price_value = {
	value = qpq_consecration_rites_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_consecration_rites_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_consecration_rites_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_consecration_rites_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_consecration_rites_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_consecration_rites_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_consecration_rites_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_character_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_character_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_consecration_rites_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_consecration_rites_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_consecration_rites_worth_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_consecration_rites_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_character_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_goal_value
	add = qpq_consecration_rites_refusal_value
}

qpq_consecration_rites_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_consecration_rites_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Temple Patronage
qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_temple_patronage_price_value = {
	value = qpq_temple_patronage_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_temple_patronage_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_temple_patronage_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_temple_patronage_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_temple_patronage_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_temple_patronage_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_temple_patronage_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_temple_patronage_demand_value
}
qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_temple_patronage_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_temple_patronage_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_temple_patronage_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_temple_patronage_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}

			add = qpq_temple_patronage_character_value
			add = qpq_temple_patronage_circumstance_value

qpq_temple_patronage_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_temple_patronage_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Join the War

		}

			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}

	min = 0
	max = 5

	min = 0.5

qpq_join_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_join_war_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5

		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_join_war_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}

qpq_join_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_join_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_join_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven }
		}
		add = -15
	}
}
qpq_join_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_join_war_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = 0
}

	value = qpq_join_war_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}

qpq_join_war_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_join_war_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_join_war_ask_value
			add = qpq_join_war_character_value
			add = qpq_join_war_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_join_war_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_join_war_ask_value
			add = qpq_join_war_character_value
			add = qpq_join_war_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_join_war_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}

	add = qpq_join_war_goodwill_value

qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	add = scope:recipient.current_military_strength
	min = 1
}

qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_join_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 18
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 10
			}
			add = {
				value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
				multiply = -0.2
				min = -15
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
				add = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient.faith = {
						faith_hostility_level = {
							target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
							value >= faith_hostile_level
						}
					}
				}
				add = 8
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add = {
					value = ai_boldness
					multiply = 0.1
				}
				add = {
					value = ai_energy
					multiply = 0.05
				}
				add = {
					value = ai_compassion
					multiply = -0.05
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
				add = 4
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
				add = 4
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
				add = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
				add = -10
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
				add = -2
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
				add = -8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
				add = 20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
				add = 10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
				add = -15
			}
			scope:actor = {
				every_character_war = {
					limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
					if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
						add = 12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
						add = 6
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
						add = -12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
						add = -6
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.0
		}
	}
}

qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	min = 1
}

qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_join_war_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		add = 8
		add = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
				add = 20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
				add = 10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
				add = -20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
				add = -10
			}
			scope:actor = {
				every_character_war = {
					limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
					if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
						add = -12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
						add = -6
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
						add = 12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
						add = 6
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.current_military_strength >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.25 } }
			add = 8
		}
	}
}

#### Stay Out of the War
qpq_stay_out_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_stay_out_price_value = {
	value = qpq_stay_out_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_stay_out_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_stay_out_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_stay_out_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_stay_out_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_stay_out_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_stay_out_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_stay_out_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

			add = qpq_stay_out_circumstance_value
