qpq_stay_out_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:secondary_recipient }
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	add = scope:recipient.current_military_strength
	min = 1
}

qpq_stay_out_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:secondary_recipient }
					every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
				else = {
					every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_stay_out_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
		add = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
				add = 18
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor } }
				add = 10
			}
			add = {
				value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
				multiply = -0.2
				min = -15
				max = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:actor } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
				add = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor }
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:actor } } }
				add = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient.faith = {
						faith_hostility_level = {
							target = scope:actor.faith
							value >= faith_hostile_level
						}
					}
				}
				add = 8
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add = {
					value = ai_boldness
					multiply = 0.1
				}
				add = {
					value = ai_energy
					multiply = 0.05
				}
				add = {
					value = ai_compassion
					multiply = -0.05
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
				add = 6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
				add = 4
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
				add = 4
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
				add = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
				add = -6
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
				add = -10
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
				add = -2
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
				add = -8
			}
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
				add = 20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
				add = 10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
				add = -15
			}
			scope:actor = {
				every_character_war = {
					limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
					if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:secondary_recipient SCORE = 40 } }
						add = 12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:secondary_recipient SCORE = 15 } }
						add = 6
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:secondary_recipient SCORE = -40 } } }
						add = -12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:secondary_recipient SCORE = -15 } } }
						add = -6
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = -0.6
		}
	}
}

qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
		add = 6
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor value <= -20 } } }
			add = 6
		}
		add = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
				add = 20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
				add = 10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
				add = -20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_stay_out_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
				add = -10
			}
			scope:actor = {
				every_character_war = {
					limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
					if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
						add = -12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
						add = -6
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
						add = 12
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
						add = 6
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.3
		}
	}

#### Heavier Tribute
qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_price_value = {
	value = qpq_heavier_tribute_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_heavier_tribute_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_heavier_tribute_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_heavier_tribute_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -25

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_war_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_worth_value = {
	value = 15
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_heavier_tribute_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_heavier_tribute_ask_value
			add = qpq_heavier_tribute_character_value
			add = qpq_heavier_tribute_circumstance_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_heavier_tribute_ask_value
			add = qpq_heavier_tribute_character_value
			add = qpq_heavier_tribute_circumstance_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_proposer_view_value = {
	value = qpq_heavier_tribute_worth_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_character_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_risk_value
	add = {
		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}
qpq_heavier_tribute_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_heavier_tribute_ask_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_goodwill_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_character_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_heavier_tribute_refusal_value

#### Lighter Tribute
qpq_lighter_tribute_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_lighter_tribute_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_lighter_tribute_price_value = {
	value = qpq_lighter_tribute_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_lighter_tribute_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_lighter_tribute_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_lighter_tribute_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_lighter_tribute_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_lighter_tribute_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_lighter_tribute_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_lighter_tribute_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_lighter_tribute_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}

	value = qpq_lighter_tribute_demand_value
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }

	}

		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_bought_freedom_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_bought_freedom_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_bought_freedom_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_bought_freedom_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = 25
}

	multiply = -5
}

		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}

		add = qpq_bought_freedom_dread_value

			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus

		max = {
			value = qpq_bought_freedom_ask_value
			add = qpq_bought_freedom_character_value
			add = qpq_bought_freedom_circumstance_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_bought_freedom_ask_value
			add = qpq_bought_freedom_character_value
			add = qpq_bought_freedom_circumstance_value
			max = 0
		}
	}

#### Accept the Yoke
qpq_accept_the_yoke_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_price_value = {
	value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_accept_the_yoke_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_accept_the_yoke_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_accept_the_yoke_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -30
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_demand_value
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_offer_points_value = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_revocation_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_council_points_value

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }

		if = {

			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value

		max = 100

			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > scope:actor.max_military_strength }
		}
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 3 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
}
qpq_accept_the_yoke_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_accept_the_yoke_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_accept_the_yoke_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_accept_the_yoke_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Cast Off the Yoke
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.suzerain }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_fort_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_coinage_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_faith_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_worth_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_risk_value = {
	value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_tier_value
	multiply = -5
}

qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goodwill_value = {
	value = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		min = 0
		add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_dread_value
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus }
			add = scope:qpq_cmd_bonus
		}
		max = {
			value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_ask_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_character_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_value
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	add = {
		value = qpq_opinion_points_value
		max = 0
		min = {
			value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_ask_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_character_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_circumstance_value
			add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_value
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

	value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_worth_value
	add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_sw_value
	add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_character_value

		value = qpq_goods_cost_value
		multiply = -1.25
	}
}

	add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_character_value

	add = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_refusal_value
}

qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.suzerain }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:recipient.suzerain)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.suzerain }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient.suzerain = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.suzerain }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:recipient.suzerain)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.suzerain }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.suzerain } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
			add = 8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
			add = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
			add = -4
		}
	}
}

#### Exchange of Goods
qpq_barter_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_barter_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_barter_price_value = {
	value = qpq_barter_demand_value
	multiply = -1.2
	add = 8
	divide = {
		value = 5
		multiply = qpq_barter_gold_mult_value
	}
	max = 20
	multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_barter_gold_mult_value = {
	value = 1
	subtract = { value = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
	min = 0.5
}
qpq_barter_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_barter_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 100
	}
	multiply = qpq_barter_gold_mult_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
